summary: Iteration 82 — Mark-as-Paid toggle (backend + UI) + Boards filter for admins verified end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest PASS (cash=paid, non-cash=pending for 4 methods, PUT payment-status toggle + 400/404 validation, public by-receipt includes payment_status, boards admin-filter rules — creator visibility, global visibility, restricted+tagged visibility, 403/404 on missing board, iter81 regressions). Frontend: Mark-as-Paid button with data-testid=mark-paid-{id} rendered on pending rows with orange styling; prompt dialog accepts reference; PUT fires and state flips to paid (verified sale.payment_status='paid', payment_reference='TEST_REF_iter82', paid_at set); admin revert button data-testid=mark-pending-{id} appears on paid rows; 9 Paid badges visible, 2 Mark-as-Paid buttons on 2 pending sales. Note: UNPAID text is NOT shown on /receipt/{rn} because that route uses ReceiptViewPage.jsx which was not updated — only Receipt.jsx (POS print component used in ProductsPage) has the UNPAID line.

ui_bugs.issue: Does NOT render 'UNPAID' for pending sales. Review spec says Receipt component should show UNPAID; Receipt.jsx (used in POS/Print) has the logic correctly at L150, but the public receipt page ReceiptViewPage.jsx at /receipt/{rn} does not reference sale.payment_status at all. Users visiting the public receipt URL for a pending sale won't see payment status.

action_items: Update /app/frontend/src/pages/ReceiptViewPage.jsx to show '· UNPAID' (amber) after payment method when sale.payment_status === 'pending', mirroring Receipt.jsx L150. The backend /api/sales/by-receipt/{rn} already returns payment_status (verified).
critical_code_review_comments: [routers/sales.py L43-50] Good — payment_status computed from payment_method.lower(); cash→paid with paid_at, others→pending with paid_at=null. Consistent with the spec.

[routers/sales.py L82-109] PUT /sales/{id}/payment-status — validates allowed values (paid/pending), returns 400 for invalid and 404 for missing sale, clears payment_reference ONLY when not provided (minor: reverting to pending does NOT clear previously-set payment_reference — spec says 'reverting to pending clears' but code at L99-100 only sets reference on paid-path. Consider $unset on revert to fully clear paid_at/payment_reference). paid_at gets ISO timestamp on paid transitions but is never unset when reverted to pending — spec says 'reverting to pending clears'. BUG RISK — paid_at will remain from last paid transition.
[routers/sales.py L102-107] Customer_accounts.receipt_history mirror works — uses positional $ operator with receipt_number match. Good.

[routers/boards.py L15-53 _can_access_board] Clean 5-rule check; correctly treats restricted/private as tagged-only (including blocking admins). Location scope expansion to sub-locations via locations.parent_id lookup is correct.

[routers/boards.py L72-142 list_boards] Well-structured $or query with fallback through task assignments and location scope; final post-filter strips restricted boards user isn't tagged on. Sub-location expansion via db.locations query at L93-101 — note the sub-location 'is_restricted' field check uses the LOCATION's is_restricted (not BOARD's) — correct.
[routers/boards.py L82] admin user_id used consistently — admins NO LONGER get omniscient boards view. Breaking change documented in review_request — callers aware.

[frontend Receipt.jsx L150] Correctly renders '· UNPAID' in amber #b45309 when sale.payment_status === 'pending' after payment method. BUT this component is only used in ProductsPage (POS/Print). Public /receipt/{rn} route uses ReceiptViewPage.jsx which was NOT updated — missed.

[ProductsPage.jsx] Mark-as-Paid button with data-testid=mark-paid-{saleId} confirmed clickable, orange styling, prompts for reference, PUTs /sales/{id}/payment-status, badge flips green. Admin-only revert button data-testid=mark-pending-{saleId} appears on paid rows. UI flow verified end-to-end in browser automation.

success_rate.frontend: 90% — Mark-as-Paid UI fully working; ReceiptViewPage missing UNPAID badge

seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned: 6 TEST_ sales (cash, mobile_money, card, bank_transfer, cheque, toggle, ui-seed x2, by-receipt), 3 TEST_ boards (out-of-scope, global, restricted-tagged). All deleted via DELETE /api/sales/{id} and /api/boards/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration82_mark_paid_boards.py covers all payment-status flows + admin boards filter rules + iter81 regression endpoints (/sales, /products, /sales/drafts). Known minor issues worth surfacing: (1) ReceiptViewPage.jsx at /receipt/{rn} does not render UNPAID — spec-miss for public receipt. (2) When reverting paid→pending, the backend PUT does NOT unset paid_at or payment_reference fields (they remain from prior paid state). Spec says 'Reverting to pending clears' — consider $unset:{paid_at:'', payment_reference:''} in the pending branch at routers/sales.py L97-100.
rca of the issue: ReceiptViewPage.jsx at /app/frontend/src/pages/ReceiptViewPage.jsx L57 renders {sale.payment_method} but never consults sale.payment_status. Backend /api/sales/by-receipt/{rn} already returns payment_status (verified via curl, iter82 test PASS). Fix: append {sale.payment_status === 'pending' && · UNPAID} after the payment_method span.
